'''Zee K'lin''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] security expert during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Among his clients were [[Eidolon Security]] and [[Nebula Communications]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Beautiful! All Zee's work. A symphony of math.|[[Anuli]]|<ref name="TOR:IE">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Industrial Espionage|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Zee K'lin sold his services to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-affiliated companies such as [[Eidolon Security]] and [[Nebula Communications]]. His services, including securing information for corporations, were in high demand.<ref name="TOR:CZ" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Zee's services to Eidolon Security made him a person of interest for the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], who was hunting [[Eidolon (assassin)|the company's founder]] as a part of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:CZ" />

The hunter had already bombed the company's manufacturing center, but sought to do more damage to the Eidolon's company, and thus draw him out of hiding. The second attack against Eidolon Security would be a leak of its private information, containing a list of clients and their security specs, and records of shipments to these clients. To acquire and leak this information, the hunter needed the security codes to bypass the data encryption that Zee had put on Eidolon Security's database. The Hunter stormed the [[Nebula Communications security offices]] in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] to catch Zee but the latter was not present. In fact, the Bith was heading to the [[Mezenti Spaceport]] in order to get a transport to [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]] for a business meeting.<ref name="TOR:CZ" />

{{GameDS}}
{{Quote|I hate&hellip; being right&hellip; all the time&hellip; |Zee K'lin, after being shot|<ref name="TOR:CZ" />}}
The Hunter eventually caught Zee in the [[Docking Bay 27 (Mezenti Spaceport)|Docking Bay 27]] before he could take off. After the hunter acquired the Eidolon Security codes from Zee, they killed him.<ref name="TOR:CZ" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player has the option of sparing Zee instead of killing him. If the player chooses this option, Zee will alert Eidolon Security's guards and they will attack the player after [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] [[Slicer/Legends|slices]] into the company's database.<ref name="TOR:CZ" />
